items.information: Get your cubes ready and test your speed! Join us for a full day of official 3x3x3 speedcubing action recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the Philippine Cubers Association (PCA)! 🏆 FEATURED EVENTS: 3x3x3 Cube (Main Event) (Dual Rounds) 3x3x3 One-Handed (Dual Rounds) 3x3x3 Blindfolded 3x3x3 Multi-Blind 💳 Registration Fee: Regular Registration: ₱500 (covers all events) On-the-Spot Registration: ₱600 (subject to slot availability on competition day) 🗓 Registration Schedule:Registration Opens: September 21, 2026 Slots are filled on a first-paid, first-served basis. Secure your spot early! 📲 Payment Details: Please refer to the Extra Registration Requirements on this WCA competition page for complete payment instructions and proof of payment submission instructions before registering. See you all at the competition floor! 🔥

items.information: ## This competition has a per-event competitor limit. Please read the [per-competitor event limit page](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BerkeleySides2026#81150-per-event-competitor-limit) for more information. * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. * Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. * Berkeley Cube Club and West Coast Cubing do not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.

items.information: **Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.** Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information. #### * **Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. items.name: RVAutumn Big and Silent 2026
items.information: **This competition only has side events and not 3x3x3 Cube, therefore, we do not recommend it for new competitors. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [other competitions in Virginia](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?search=Virginia); Such as [RVAutumn 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RVAutumn2026).** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. Additionally, we recommend you attend the Newcomer Tutorial at the beginning of the Competition.
